instruction: Arrange the five nesting dolls in a row from left to right, from smallest to largest.

arguments.note: The five dolls increase in size from the small rear-center doll to the large left doll. I am raising both hands to clear them before preparing vertical grasps.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 31 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: Both hands cleared the dolls but stopped short of the requested pose. I finish turning the tools downward for stable upright transfers.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 28 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: I approach the largest doll from above. The intended final row will be in the clear foreground, leaving room to place each size upright.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The largest doll is centered between the open jaws in the wrist view. I lower toward its upper body while leaving its base free.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 19 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The wrist view shows the doll toward the near side of the hand. I shift back to align the grasp with its rounded head before closing.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The doll’s head is still nearer than the jaw center. I bring the open hand back over it, keeping the descent modest.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The head is now centered laterally between the jaws. I lower to a grasping band just below its top.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws surround the largest doll’s upper body. I close them without changing the pose.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The gripper stopped against the doll rather than closing empty. I lift it vertically to verify the grasp and clear the table.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 12 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The largest doll lifted securely. I carry it across the clear foreground toward the rightmost position of a row at y approximately -0.32.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 24 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The doll remains upright and clear of the table. I continue the lateral transfer in a reachable segment.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The longer cross-body target was refused without motion. I try a shorter, slightly lower transfer while retaining ample table clearance.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 9 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will stage the largest doll here for the right arm rather than force a cross-body reach. I lower it until its base is just above the table.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The staged doll is nearly down. I lower another nine millimetres before the final contact adjustment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I settle the base the final four millimetres and release the largest doll upright at the staging position.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The last 3 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The largest doll is released. I withdraw vertically so the right arm can approach without crossing the left gripper.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 14 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I move the left hand away from the staged largest doll, clearing the center for the right hand.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 17 waypoints (0.7s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The largest doll stands securely at the staging point. I bring the right hand above the same grasp location.

arguments.note: The right wrist confirms alignment over the largest doll. I descend to just above the previously successful grasp height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 10 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The right jaws are centered around the head. I lower four millimetres and grasp the largest doll for its final transfer.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The right gripper has firm contact with the largest doll. I lift vertically before moving it to the right end of the row.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 10 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The largest doll is securely lifted. I carry it to the rightmost slot, keeping its base above the other objects.

arguments.note: The base is close to the table. I lower seven millimetres before the final settling and release.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The combined approach was refused, so neither hand moved. I first clear the placed largest doll with the right hand alone.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 12 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I approach the second-largest doll behind the placed largest one. It will occupy the adjacent slot to its left.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 10 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The wrist view shows the second-largest doll slightly right and ahead of the hand. I align over its upper body and descend toward the grasp height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The doll is centered laterally, but its head lies toward the near side. I correct back and lower eight millimetres to surround the head.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws now surround the upper body. I make a final few-millimetre adjustment and close around the second-largest doll.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 10 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The second-largest doll lifted successfully. I carry it to the slot immediately left of the largest doll.

arguments.note: Two dolls now occupy the right end of the row. I clear the right hand and angle the left tool to improve reach toward the smallest doll.

arguments.note: With the tool angled for reach, I approach the smallest doll from above and the near side.

arguments.note: The smallest doll remains centered laterally. I approach its upper body with a short downward and backward motion.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The smallest doll lifted successfully. I carry it toward the left end of the foreground row without rotating the held doll.

arguments.note: The smallest doll is over the leftmost slot. I lower it to about a centimetre above its original resting height.
